items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: We had Snooky Young, Clark Terry, myself and Emmett Berry.

ctx.x: Yes, I know that. I was wondering why -- you know, I always thought of Crawford as playing in Memphis but I knew Sy came from up there.

He's from Zanesville. And the Mills Brothers are from Pickaway, Ohio. They're from Ohio. Earl Warren is from Ohio. Teddy Wilson spent a lot of time in Ohio with Speed Webb, he was from Ohio. Chick Carter, Snooky Young's old boss, he's from Ohio. Art Tatum was from Toledo. There are many, many good musicians from Ohio. Eli Robertson, the trombone player, he was from around Ohio.
But see, all those bands used to station themselves in Ohio, Columbus, because they could go to Cincinnati, only 90 miles, go to Steubenville, only 60 miles.

items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had Al Grey, Snooky Young, and myself... So was Snooky, Snooky Young, great musician, great reader.

ctx.x: But at least for that tour, you were able to….

It was a good band. It was a fantastic band and in fact, we had more Basie men in that band than was in the Frank Foster band. We had Al Grey, Snooky Young, and myself. Billy Mitchell, Eddie Jones, Marshall Royal.
